markets.rules_primary: If Frankfurt and Hoffenheim both score a goal in the Frankfurt vs Hoffenheim Bundesliga match originally scheduled for Nov 21, 2026 after 90 minutes plus stoppage time (does not include extra time or penalties), then the market resolves to Yes.
